title: SLogic: Subgraph-Informed Logical Rule Learning for Knowledge Graph Completion
abstract: arXiv:2510.00279v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Logical rule-based methods offer an interpretable approach to knowledge graph completion (KGC) by capturing compositional relationships in the form of human-readable inference rules. While existing logical rule-based methods learn rule confidence scores, they typically assign a global weight to each rule schema, applied uniformly across the graph. This is a significant limitation, as a rule's importance often varies depending on the specific query instance. To address this, we introduce SLogic (Subgraph-Informed Logical Rule learning), a novel framework that assigns query-dependent scores to logical rules. The core of SLogic is a context-aware scoring function. This framework is in line with the specificity principle in commonsense reasoning. translated_title: 基于子图信息的逻辑规则学习用于知识图谱补全
translated_abstract: arXiv:2510.00279v3 公告类型：交叉替换 摘要：基于逻辑规则的方法通过以人类可读的推理规则形式捕捉组合关系，为知识图谱补全（KGC）提供了一种可解释的方法。虽然现有的基于逻辑规则的方法学习规则置信度分数，但它们通常为每个规则模式分配一个全局权重，并在整个图谱中统一应用。这是一个显著的局限性，因为规则的重要性往往因具体查询实例而异。为解决这一问题，我们引入了SLogic（子图信息逻辑规则学习），一种新颖的框架，为逻辑规则分配查询相关的分数。SLogic的核心是一个上下文感知的评分函数。该框架符合常识推理中的特异性原则。该函数通过分析查询头实体局部定义的子图来确定规则的重要性，从而实现对特定规则的差异化加权。
tldr: SLogic提出了一种上下文感知的评分函数，通过分析查询头实体的局部子图为每条逻辑规则分配查询相关的动态权重，克服了传统方法中规则全局权重固定的局限，提升了知识图谱补全的准确性和可解释性。
en_tdlr: SLogic introduces a context-aware scoring function that assigns query-dependent dynamic weights to logical rules by analyzing the local subgraph of the query head entity, overcoming the limitation of fixed global rule weights in traditional methods and improving both accuracy and interpretability in knowledge graph completion.
